APPEARANCE Appearance Theme dark light Text scale Comfort Large Accessibility html[data-scale=comfort] Language English Sinhala strings marked for operator native review VISUAL QUALITY Visual quality frosted Frosted glass is the default on browsers that support it. Choose Opaque at any time, and every accessibility setting below wins over this choice. Glass quality Glass quality Auto Opaque Frosted Clear Auto uses the frosted presentation when the browser supports it. Opaque keeps solid surfaces. Frosted and Clear force one look on every browser that can render it. Surface tint Surface tint Tinted Clear Tinted keeps a stronger fill for content-heavy panels. Clear lets more of the backdrop show through and suits chrome. Glass clarity 75% clear 0% 25% 50% 75% 100% Higher clarity means a more transparent surface. The value snaps to fixed steps so the blur is never rebuilt while you drag. requested=auto resolved=frosted variant=tinted clarity=0.75 ABOUT THIS BUILD Build identity served = built SOURCE REVISION dev SERVED (#GHRDPBUILD) dev ARTIFACT ui-dist-dev.zip BACKEND RELEASE not checked Re-c
